title: Muse Glimmer 30B held-out orchestrator evaluations, paired ablations, 2x T4 memory experiment, and operational policy snapshot

serving_status.glimmer_adapter_endpoint: Adopted rank-16 none-fix adapter verified on a dedicated serverless H100 evaluation endpoint at 17:25 UTC on 2026-11-02: 7 calls recorded correct, comprising 1 cold call at 55.2 seconds and 6 warm calls across four roles with a combined median of 3.27 seconds. This is a small recorded trial, not a general latency guarantee. Adapter weights stay private under base model terms.
serving_status.eranos_live_worker_fleet: These records do not establish routine Glimmer routing in live Eranos workers. The recorded fleet policy uses Meta's hosted Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 under hourly Thompson sampling.

setup.h100_orchestrator_runs: One NVIDIA H100 80GB; full bfloat16 (bf16) base weights of Muse Glimmer 30B + rank-16 LoRA on 7 projections across 52 text layers (95,846,400 trainable parameters, no 4-bit quantization), 1 epoch over 1,762 training rows; greedy decoding in a single shared session
setup.t4_lora_as_memory_experiment: Separate 2026-10-31 experiment on 2x NVIDIA T4 using 4-bit NF4 QLoRA over 120 held-out Tasks (60 post-cutoff 2026 Task Object recalls + 60 nonprofit intake splits)
setup.operational_policy_snapshot: Hourly Thompson-sampling policy (tuner_version 28, read 2026-11-02, 15 recorded outcomes) over Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 variants

preregistered_splits.isolation: Frozen before training; shares no seed pack, sentence bank, or normalized user text with training rows; zero Meta API outputs in training data. Later ablations and adoption reused the holdouts, so these are development evaluations rather than a fresh post-selection confirmation.

derived_abstention_split.construction: Derived from the retrieval holdout by replacing each matched Task Object with a non-matching same-kind sibling; manual audit of 54 filtered rows found 0 wrong labels (95% upper bound 6.6%).

adopted_none_fix_rank_16.top_pick_precision_scope: Answer-present subset only: 155/156. Original mixed 194-case set: 155/158 named answers correct. Derived 153-case no-match set: 25 false matches.

retrieval_recall_at_5.note: 8-point recall@5 tradeoff when abstaining on 19 of 175 matched queries. Lexical top-5 fallback is proposed; combined pipeline accuracy, latency and cost are not measured here.

review_false_accept_rate.note: Interval includes zero; 2 of 126 vs 1 of 126 is a sample observation.

routing_task_object_f1.finding: Adopted rank-16 variant reached 97.9% Task-Object F1 (first rank-16 adapter 97.8% vs 4x larger rank-64 adapter 89.6%).

retrieval_task_object_selection.top_pick_precision_scope: Answer-present subset only: 155/156. Original mixed 194-case set: 155/158 named answers correct. Derived 153-case no-match set: 25 false matches.

lora_as_memory_zero_shim_tokens.median_amortized_batch_generation_speedu: 2.28x (19.749 s to 8.668 s per row, batch size 8)
lora_as_memory_zero_shim_tokens.timing_scope: Batch duration divided by row count, not individual request latency.
